ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the anomaly correlation record was ingested into the raw-data store

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced the record (Jira_CAMS_Cloud_Anomaly_Correlation)

reportName.description: Jira REST self URL of the source issue

reportFolder.description: Source folder of the ingested report

key.description: Jira issue key uniquely identifying the anomaly correlation record

title.description: Title taken from the Jira issue summary

status.description: Current workflow status of the Jira issue

created.description: Date the anomaly correlation issue was created in Jira

updated.description: Date the anomaly correlation issue was last updated in Jira

issue.description: Key of the CAMS anomaly issue this correlation is linked to (derived from Jira issue links)

summary.description: Summary text of the Jira anomaly correlation issue

description.description: Free-text description of the anomaly (Jira description field)

station_type.description: Type of ground station involved (Jira station custom field, parent value)

station.description: Ground station involved (Jira station custom field, child value)

impacted_passes.description: Acquisition passes impacted by the anomaly (Jira impacted-passes custom field)

impacted_observations.description: Observations impacted by the anomaly (Jira impacted-observations custom field)

origin.description: Origin of the anomaly (Jira origin custom field)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit(s) impacted by the anomaly (Jira satellite-unit custom field)

products.description: Names of the products impacted by the anomaly (Jira products custom field)
